pairs.why: The two are nearly identical, but B's strap leather is slightly smoother and plainer, which fits the soft, clean finish of the real cards better.
A's strap is smooth leather with no stitching, which matches the smooth real cards; B's stitched strap adds texture the real cards don't have.
B's plain metal cover is slightly softer and less chrome-glossy, closer to the soft finish of the real cards; A's rivets add a shinier, harder metal look.
This is the same pair with the sides swapped: A's plain, softer metal fits better than B's shinier riveted chrome.
The cacti are the same, but A's plain purple gradient backdrop matches the real vending-machine card; B adds concentric rings the real card doesn't have.
This is the same pair with the sides swapped: B has the plain gradient backdrop like the real card, while A has the extra rings.
B's solid red inlay is smoother and simpler, like the real gloves and chair; A's dotted stitching and spurs add the fine texture the lessons marked as too texture-y.
This is the same pair with the sides swapped: A's smooth solid inlay fits the real cards better than B's stitched, detailed version.
